# Pax Renewal Center

> > Pax Renewal Center offers faith-integrated mental health counseling and therapy services in Lafayette, Louisiana, specializing in CBT, trauma recovery, and relationship support.

Led by Dan Jurek, M.A., LPC-S, LMFT-S, Pax Renewal Center provides evidence-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy combined with Christian principles for individuals and couples. Services include trauma-focused therapy, marriage counseling, and remote therapy options for long-distance clients.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dan Jurek, M.A., LPC-S, LMFT-S
- Faith-based counseling
- Trauma-Focused therapy
- Christian Trauma Healing Network
- Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs)
- Couples therapy
- Long-distance counseling
- Lafayette, Louisiana
- Online therapy
- Discernment counseling
- Anxiety and depression treatment
- Life transitions
- Catholic marriage support
- Premarital counseling

## Core Therapy Services

- [CBT Therapy Lafayette LA: Renew Your Mind 2025](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/cbt-therapy-lafayette-la-ultimate-guide): CBT therapy services in Lafayette, LA by Pax Renewal Center
- [Faith based CBT 2025: Transform Mental Healing](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/spirit-science-how-christian-therapy-can-transform-your-mental-health): Faith-based CBT integrating Christian principles with mental health therapy
- [Counseling for Childhood Trauma: Heal in 2025](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/counseling-for-childhood-trauma): Childhood trauma counseling services and evidence-based therapies
- [Discernment Counseling: 3 Paths to Clarity](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/discernment-counseling-ultimate-guide): Discernment counseling for couples facing marriage crisis decisions

## Couples & Relationship Counseling

- [Long distance couples counseling: Best Guide 2025](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/best-long-distance-couples-counseling-guide): Guide to long-distance couples counseling by Pax Renewal Center
- [Long Distance Premarital Counseling: Crucial 2025 Guide](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/long-distance-premarital-counseling): Premarital counseling guide for long-distance relationships
- [Catholic marriage help: 4 Pillars to Thrive](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/catholic-marriage-help): Catholic marriage counseling guide with faith-based support tools

## Trauma & Life Transitions

- [Christian Trauma Healing Network: Top 5 Powerful Healing Paths 2025](https://paxrenewalcenter.com/finding-peace-after-pain-with-christian-trauma-support-groups): Faith-based trauma healing resources and support group guide
